title: My balance – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: My balance
hero.lead: This area combines personal consumption entries, fines, rewards, payments and payouts in one account.

body:
Understand the three amounts

  • My balance: the current difference between charges and credits. Kaderblick indicates whether an amount is owed, the account is settled or it has credit.
  • Consumed: the sum of personal charges.
  • Paid: the sum of recorded payments.

Switch between people

If your account is allowed to open the account of other assigned people, a Person field appears above the totals. Select yourself or one of the offered players there. If the field is absent, you can only see your own account.

Add an entry

  1. Select Add to balance or select an offered catalogue item directly.
  2. Select From catalogue to use an existing item, then choose the item and, where required, the team or club.
  3. Select Free entry if no suitable item exists. Enter a description and amount and assign the entry to one of the offered teams or clubs.
  4. Enter the quantity; the minimum is 1.
  5. Check the date, add an optional note and review the displayed total.
  6. Select Book.

Read the history

The newest transactions appear first. Each row contains the date, transaction, quantity and amount. It may also show a category, team or club, note and these labels:

  • Fine or Reward identifies an entry from the fines catalogue.
  • Free text identifies an entry without a catalogue item.
  • Payment received and Payout originate from settlement by an authorised cashier.
  • Cancellation and Cancelled identify reversed transactions.
  • A payment allocation shows which outstanding items a payment settled.

Edit or cancel your own entry

  • The pencil changes the quantity, date and note of your own entry.
  • The bin opens cancellation. An entry that has already been settled, cancelled or was itself created as a cancellation cannot be cancelled again there.
  • These two actions are absent when you have opened another person’s account.

Roles and relations

  • Players and coaches: see their own balance and transactions.
  • Parents and other player relations: can additionally switch between the people offered by Kaderblick.
  • Cashiers and authorised managers: handle payments, corrections and overviews in the cashbook, not through the personal editing icons on somebody else’s account.
  • Supporters: cannot access other people’s accounts without an additional person or cashier relation.

Related areas

  • Fines and rewards originate from the fines catalogue.
  • Catalogue items, payments, payouts and corrections are managed in the cashbook.
